name: Ibara Hime ga Sunao ni Naru Made
original_name: いばら姫が素直になるまで
source:
Cursed by a fairy, Aurelia (named fixed) awakens from a century-long slumber thanks to a kiss from Prince Philibert. However, the castle remains ensnared in thorns, and all its other inhabitants lie fast asleep, showing no signs of stirring.

Though bewildered by the hundred-year generation gap separating her from the present, Aurelia joins forces with Philibert and the knight Leandre to seek a way to break the curse upon the castle.
And when she finally reaches her destination, what decision will Aurelia make...?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12105]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
受到仙女诅咒的奥里莉亚（名为固定）在菲利伯特王子的吻下从长达一个世纪的沉睡中醒来。然而，城堡仍然被荆棘所困，所有其他居民都在熟睡，没有任何动静的迹象。

尽管奥里莉亚对自己与现在之间的百年代沟感到困惑，但她还是与菲利伯特和骑士利安德联手寻找打破城堡诅咒的方法。
而当她最终到达目的地时，奥蕾莉亚又会做出怎样的决定……？

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12105]Novelgame[/url]]
